name: Barbell Bench Press
imageCaption: Barbell bench press, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the bar is lowered to the chest (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your chest slowly.
Push the bar up until your arms are straight.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
imageCaption: Incline dumbbell press, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the dumbbells are pressed up over the chest (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Set the bench to an incline, about 30 to 45 degrees.
Sit down and hold one dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower them slowly to shoulder level.

name: Push-Up
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the chest is lowered to the floor (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Put your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.

name: Cable Chest Fly
imageCaption: Cable chest fly, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the hands meet in front of the chest (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand between two cable machines.
Hold one handle in each hand with a small bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly back to the start.

name: Chest Dip
imageCaption: Chest dip, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the elbows are bent and the body is down (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Hold the parallel bars and lift your body.
Lean your upper body a little forward.
Bend your elbows and go down slowly.
Push up until your arms are straight.
